title: Real Madrid capture Liga ACB title
description: Real Madrid - Barca 81-74 Real Madrid are 2021/22 Liga ACB champions. They overcame Barca in the fourth game of the Final to clinch the trophy. Walter Tavares (220-C-1992) notched 25 points and 13 rebounds to pace the hosts and was named the MVP. Real Madrid limited their opponents to just 10 points in the first period to take a 3-point lead. Barca sank 23 points in the second frame to narrow the deficit at 1-point 34-33. The teams went neck and neck throughout the third term. Real Madrid entered the fourth quarter up by one point. The hosts then finished the game strong. Real poured in 24 points in the fourth stanza and raced to the first Liga ACB title since 2018/19 season. Fabien Causeur (196-F-1987) posted 17 points to lead the winners. Nikola Mirotic (208-PF-1991) replied with 14 points for Barca. Dante Exum (198-PG-1995, agency: Alti Sport) had 13 points in the loss.
